events.verdict: LAR shows Harrell (LAC) goes to and not through Smart (BOS) at the end of his drive. Smart's (BOS) reaction is not consistent with the contact from Harrell (LAC).
RLS shows Harrell (LAC) makes clean contact with the ball and then makes incidental contact to Hayward's (BOS) arm.
Hayward (BOS) makes marginal contact with Harrell (LAC) during his driving shot but does not affect his ability to finish at the rim.
As Horford (BOS) releases from the pick he briefly extends two arms into Shamet (LAC) but does not affect his ability to defend.
Horford (BOS) engages with Shamet (LAC) during his post up but does not affect his ability to defend.
Gallinari (LAC) is in the paint for less than three seconds when he is imminently exiting.
RLB shows Shamet (LAC) cleanly dislodges the entry pass intended for Hayward (BOS).

[Observable in enhanced video] Horford (BOS) extends his leg and intentionally kicks the ball. The only conclusive angle that shows both the extension and definitive contact with the ball is the opposite above the rim camera (LAR).
Rozier (BOS) commits a take foul on Williams (LAC).
Rozier (BOS) commits a take foul on Williams (LAC).
MOB shows Tatum (BOS) makes incidental contact to Harrell's (LAC) head after the release of the driving shot attempt. Tatum is in a normal shooting motion.
Harrell (LAC) jumps vertically and maintains a legal vertical position contesting the driving shot attempt by Tatum (BOS).
Hayward (BOS) commits a take foul on Beverley (LAC).
Williams (LAC) makes incidental "high-five" contact with Rozier (BOS) after the release that does not affect his jump shot attempt.

The crew communicated with the Replay Center to determine if the foul committed by the Celtics Jayson Tatum met the criteria for a flagrant foul. After the review Tatum was assessed a flagrant foul type 1 as the foul penalty.
